verdict.rationale: Kushki has a first-party docs page on refunds ('Returns, cancellations, and refunds' / 'Devoluciones, anulaciones y reembolsos'), so refunds are a documented capability. The evidence is only page titles, though, and doesn't show how refunds work or which channels support them. Missing for 10: evidence of partial vs. full refund amounts, evidence of issuing refunds from the dashboard, explicit refund API endpoint details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
